class.name: SpatialSoundEventPolicy
class.brief_description: Early spatial distance and retrigger-time admission for repeated cosmetic 3D sound events.
class.description: Unreal Sound Concurrency-inspired pure policy that can reject duplicate sounds in a small world area before allocating AudioStreamPlayer3D nodes or performing expensive obstruction checks. The caller owns the per-sound last successfully emitted time and location; this policy has no mutable global history, no AudioServer calls and no changes to authoritative game events. Sound concurrency voice limits are still applied separately.

method.name: should_emit
method.description: Returns false for a non-finite source position, events beyond max_distance plus 2 m when a listener is known, or repeat events from within merge_radius strictly before retrigger_seconds have elapsed. Negative last_seconds means no previous event. Invalid optional timing/radius parameters fail open, as does a missing listener. The game only applies positive retrigger windows to low-priority repeated foley and retains weapon/killsounds without this suppression.
